_meta.label: AI-generated data file: built by code written with an AI assistant (Claude Code); no language model ran to build it. It traces numbers in the team's AI-extracted catalog text to NASA PSI records and tables; a found number is not a check of its meaning. Team output, not a NASA conclusion.

description: Trace audit of the numbers in the AI-extracted catalog text that the page shows, and linter hits in text pm does not own. A status says the number was found in a NASA source, not that its meaning was checked. Catalog values remain AI-extracted and not yet checked by a person.

rules.numbers: ai.checks.extract_numbers (the number gate's extraction); thousands commas removed; digits inside identifiers are not numbers
rules.follower: the unit after the number (ai.checks unit list, normalised; a unit written as a word such as 'meters' counts as that unit; a number joined to the next one by a dash, 'to', 'x', a comma or 'and' takes that number's unit), or else the next word in lower case, stemmed, or none
rules.not_audited: gravity-level names (1 g, 0 g) and numbers that are part of a name ('Test 1') are listed, not traced
rules.found_in_psi_text: numeral as written in the investigation's PSI title, objective, approach, hypothesis, researchImpacts or a publication title; below 100 the follower must match too
rules.found_in_table_cell: (a) values_long.csv value of the investigation equal at the printed precision, same unit when both carry one, not for a unitless single-digit integer; (b) numeral as written in a cell of the investigation's NASA table, same unit (in the cell or the column header) when the catalog gives one
rules.found_as_count: publications, publication DOIs, table rows (per source, investigation or fuel_material), integer column sums of a raw table, or one test_end / flow_event category (per source, investigation or fuel_material)
rules.meaning: A status says the number was found, not that its meaning was checked.
